Subject: Payment structure question for 3-year proposal

Hi Dylan,

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning — the product looked great and the model performance on our pilot was convincing. We want to move forward with a 3-year commitment but need flexibility on payment timing. Our preferred structure is: partial upfront, then milestone invoices tied to annual capacity ramp with Net 90 on milestone invoices.

High level ask: 3-year committed spend of $2.4M total. Can Redwood accept 40% at signing (upfront), then two milestone invoices at 30% each invoiced at each 12-month anniversary with Net 90 terms?

We can provide a PO from procurement and a corporate guarantee. If needed, we can discuss an escrow arrangement for the milestone amounts. Please confirm what Redwood can accommodate and any discount implications for multi-year prepay.

Attachments: (1) Stratus procurement terms (procurement_PO_template.pdf)

Thanks,
Elena Rossi

StratusData

- Commercial discount: 20% off list for annual prepays; additional 5% term discount for a signed 3-year commit (total 25% off list if we land on the prepay schedule below).

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Fwd: Payment structure question for 3-year proposal — finance perspective

Team — quick finance take after reviewing the draft:

1) Net 90 on milestone invoices for a three-year commitment is outside our standard for new customers at this scale. Approvals are possible but must meet one of the following conditions:
   a) Increase upfront to 50% of total ($1,200,000) and accept Net 90 on remaining invoices; OR
   b) Keep 40% upfront but require a corporate guarantee + signed PO + milestone escrow hold using a 3rd-party escrow agent for the milestone amounts; OR
   c) Keep 40% upfront and change milestone invoices to Net 60 — Finance can approve Net 60 with no escrow if a signed PO is in place.

2) Discount: the 25% net discount is aggressive but acceptable given projected volume and references. We should tie the additional 5% term discount to: (i) signed 3-year SOW/term sheet; and (ii) Stratus commits to providing a PO and annual prepay for Years 2/3 if they elect to prepay at anniversary (i.e., no retroactive refunds).

3) Operational ask: include an SLA exception in the contract that allows Redwood to throttle burst capacity if they do not pay milestone invoices within agreed windows. This is a standard risk control and should be communicated up front.

Please advise which option you want to present back to Stratus. My preference is option (b) — keep commercial upside while protecting cashflow.

-Karthik
VP, Finance
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Payment structure question for 3-year proposal — proposed commercial terms

Elena — after internal review we can move forward with a conditional agreement. Summary of proposed terms for StratusData to confirm: 

1) Commercial: 3-year commitment, total $2,400,000. Cumulative discount 25% off list (20% annual prepay baseline + 5% three-year term).

2) Payment schedule: 40% upfront at signing ($960,000), 30% invoice at 12 months ($720,000), 30% invoice at 24 months ($720,000). Milestone invoices will be issued on the anniversaries.

3) Payment terms & credit safeguards (choose one to confirm):
   - Option A (preferred by Redwood): Keep 40% upfront and provide a corporate guarantee + signed PO from Stratus + set up a third-party escrow for the two milestone invoices.
   - Option B: Increase upfront to 50% ($1,200,000) and accept Net 90 on the remaining invoices (no escrow required).
   - Option C: Keep 40% upfront but change milestone invoices to Net 60 with a signed PO (no escrow required).

4) SLAs: standard Redwood SLA applies; we will include a contractual clause that allows capacity controls if invoices are >60 days overdue after milestone due dates.

Next steps: please let me know which option you prefer. If Option A, I will send the term sheet for signature and the DocuSign room; if Option B/C, we'll update the term sheet and route to DocuSign. Attaching the current term sheet and SOW for your legal team to review — term_sheet_stratus_v1.xlsx, SOW_Stratus_v2.pdf.

DocuSign room (will be populated once you confirm): https://www.docusign.com/rooms/abc123-stratus-docusign

Thanks and look forward to closing this out quickly — we can have final docs ready within 5 business days after you pick an option.

Best,
